ablation.why_no_refit: A refit would be a NEW CANDIDATE selecting on the same consumed tape. Masking at inference changes nothing about what was fitted or when; it removes one term's contribution at scoring time and inherits the parent's freeze instant, so it borrows no additional look at the data.

declared_nulls.design: permuted-target refit — shuffle the 5-second drift target, REFIT the same OLS, re-gate, recompute. Refit-style because a feature-only placebo cannot price free-parameter optimism.
declared_nulls.why_200: BE ran 8, saw a result, ran 30, and the verdict REVERSED on two cells. A null max is an extreme-order statistic biased downward at small counts, so an UNDER-SAMPLED CORRECT NULL FLATTERS AS MUCH AS A WRONG ONE.

era_purity_disclosure.ONE_FEATURE_IS_NOT: sw_maxrun_1s = longest same-direction trade RUN depends on WITHIN-SECOND ORDERING, i.e. sub-second structure, which pre-boundary rows do not reliably carry: p99 holds up to ~0.6s of parse-backlog error CONCENTRATED IN BURSTS. A sweep IS a burst, so the exposure is worst exactly where the feature is supposed to fire. The other five sweep features are order-free and 1s-safe.
era_purity_disclosure.disposition: BE does NOT silently drop the feature — that would refit and void the freeze. sw_maxrun_1s is FLAGGED as era-exposed; the forward evaluation must report v4 both WITH and WITHOUT it, and forward tape is all POST-boundary so forward scoring is clean either way.
